subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic approval policy and require an explicit operator decision before the destructive write?
rationale: The recently merged policy intentionally removed redundant Gateway approval after a user directs an agent to apply a proposal; this patch introduces a safety exception whose thresholds also affect legitimate short skills and complete rewrites.

options.title: Keep the conditional gate
options.body: Require explicit approval only when an update retains fewer than three non-heading lines or less than half of the original body, while continuous edits remain automatic.

options.title: Preserve unconditional automatic apply
options.body: Reject structurally invalid content but allow every structurally valid proposal to follow the existing automatic approval policy.

options.title: Gate every update
options.body: Require explicit operator approval for all updates, simplifying the safety rule at the cost of broader workflow friction.

recommendation.title: Keep the conditional gate
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only when an update retains fewer than three non-heading lines or less than half of the original body, while continuous edits remain automatic.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and merged the automatic approval behavior whose contract must be reconciled with the proposed safety exception.
